Given The PRD set has the root document and 4 sections at draft, and 13 sections at pending. The engineering lead wants an early copy.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then The file shows the word "Draft" and version 0.1.0 on the first page. The contents list shows the status and score of every section. Each pending section says that it is not written yet.
